source_checks.title: Hawaii DLNR Division of Forestry and Wildlife
CIFFC National Fire Situation Report
source_checks.detail: Machine collector received a minimal response; the Aug 9 CIFFC sitrep was timestamped 8:01 PM EDT, just after the 8:00 PM cutoff, so the Aug 8 current-fires summary controls this run.

national_posture.statement: The August 9 IMSR placed the United States at National Preparedness Level 5, with 94 uncontained large fires, 147 active incidents, and 30,419 personnel assigned.
national_posture.level_meaning: national resources are fully committed, active geographic areas may need emergency measures, and potential for additional significant fires is high

national_posture.statement: The latest CIFFC summary available before the cutoff kept Canada at National Preparedness Level 5. The Aug 8 current-fires summary showed 123 full-response fires covering 988,546.8 hectares and 4,566 fires covering 3,902,318.5 hectares year to date; the Aug 9 sitrep was timestamped 8:01 PM EDT, just after cutoff.
national_posture.level_meaning: national demand is extreme, resources are fully committed, and international resources are being mobilized to sustain operations

incidents.name: Old Trails Fire
incidents.location: West of Spokane near Airway Heights
incidents.controlling_agency: California Interagency Incident Management Team 7 and Washington Department of Natural Resources

evacuation.description: Evacuations and area, road, and trail closures remained in effect around the Spokane fires.

incidents.operational_outlook: At the cutoff, the Aug 9 NIFC row controlled the 3,226-acre, 43%-contained operational record and described moderate fire behavior with structures and infrastructure threatened.

attention.coverage_summary: Coverage focused on the arson case, a reported rise in burned structures, assistance for affected residents, and containment progress.
attention.methodology_note: Browser-visible search was capped at 60 unique result links; counts are censored observations and no auditable public-discussion count was available.

incidents.analyst_note: **Cat-modeling interpretation:** The IMSR's 600 losses are unspecified structures and must not be converted into dwellings. ([NIFC IMSR](https://www.nifc.gov/nicc/sitreprt.pdf))
critical_alert_reasons: at least 25 newly damaged or destroyed structures
named community under evacuation with structure involvement or imminent threat

incidents.name: Widemouth 2 Fire
incidents.location: Fishlake National Forest between Kanosh, Meadow, and Fillmore
incidents.controlling_agency: Great Basin Complex Incident Management Team 2 and Fishlake National Forest

evacuation.description: The IMSR reported evacuations, road and area closures; the incident page directs residents to local evacuation information.

incidents.operational_outlook: The Aug 9 NIFC row reported extreme fire behavior and numerous structures and infrastructure threatened; the Aug 9 InciWeb page confirmed the 114,957-acre, 27%-contained operational record before cutoff.

attention.coverage_summary: Coverage focused on the fatal firefighting-helicopter crash, recovery of the crew, I-70 protection, and continued fire growth.
attention.methodology_note: News-area estimates do not replace the official IMSR acreage in the operational record.

incidents.analyst_note: **Source reconciliation:** The Aug 9 InciWeb page controls the 114,957-acre, 27%-contained operational record at the cutoff. ([NIFC IMSR](https://www.nifc.gov/nicc/sitreprt.pdf))
critical_alert_reasons: named community under evacuation with structure involvement or imminent threat

incidents.name: Grasshopper Fire
incidents.location: Mt. Hood National Forest near Highway 35
incidents.controlling_agency: U.S. Forest Service, Mt. Hood National Forest

evacuation.description: Incident information directs residents to current county evacuation levels and notes a forest closure order.

incidents.operational_outlook: The Aug 9 InciWeb page reported 57,087 acres and 23% containment with evacuation guidance and closures; the IMSR reported active behavior with structures and critical infrastructure threatened.

attention.coverage_summary: Coverage emphasized growth above 54,000 acres, National Guard support, Highway 35 protection, and evacuation constraints.
attention.methodology_note: Result count is a browser-visible, title-attributed sample; no auditable public-discussion count was available.

incidents.analyst_note: **Cat-modeling interpretation:** Official sources report qualitative structural and infrastructure threat, not a numeric structure-loss count. ([InciWeb](https://inciweb.wildfire.gov/incident-information/ormhf-grasshopper))
critical_alert_reasons: named community under evacuation with structure involvement or imminent threat

incidents.name: Bradley Creek Fire
incidents.location: Okanagan Indian Band reserve near Vernon

evacuation.description: Evacuation orders and alerts remained mapped around the Okanagan Indian Band and neighboring jurisdictions.

incidents.operational_outlook: CIFFC retained Bradley Creek as an out-of-control priority fire; current coverage described smoke moderating behavior but wind risk ahead.

attention.coverage_summary: Coverage centered on the Okanagan Indian Band's recovery, smoke effects on behavior, evacuation changes, and wind risk.
attention.methodology_note: No auditable public-discussion count was available.

incidents.analyst_note: **Cat-modeling interpretation:** The roughly 230-home estimate is preliminary and is not a completed parcel-level assessment. ([Associated Press](https://apnews.com/article/wildfire-canada-homes-destroyed-british-columbia-fbbb7f027adb04a9c9b47a109de74082))
critical_alert_reasons: at least 25 newly damaged or destroyed structures
named community under evacuation with structure involvement or imminent threat

incidents.name: Aspen Acres Fire
incidents.controlling_agency: Rocky Mountain Complex Incident Management Team 3

evacuation.description: Area and road closures remained in effect; the reviewed update did not quantify active evacuations.

incidents.operational_outlook: Minimal fire behavior continued at 72% containment, while managers reported hot spots and an unstable atmosphere with area closures in effect.

attention.coverage_summary: Coverage emphasized smoke, highway reopening, recovery fundraising, and stable containment rather than a new loss increment.
attention.methodology_note: No auditable public-discussion count was available.

incidents.analyst_note: **Cat-modeling interpretation:** The 915 lost structures are cumulative and unspecified by occupancy. ([NIFC IMSR](https://www.nifc.gov/nicc/sitreprt.pdf))

incidents.name: Kaiser Canyon Fire
incidents.controlling_agency: Bureau of Indian Affairs and Alaska Incident Management Team 2

evacuation.description: Evacuations and road closures remained in effect near the incident.

incidents.operational_outlook: The Aug 9 InciWeb update reports active behavior while NIFC reports numerous structures and communication infrastructure threatened.

attention.coverage_summary: Coverage was limited and largely folded into wider eastern Washington fire coverage.
attention.methodology_note: No auditable public-discussion count was available.

incidents.analyst_note: **Cat-modeling interpretation:** The 44 losses are cumulative and unspecified by occupancy. ([NIFC IMSR](https://www.nifc.gov/nicc/sitreprt.pdf))
critical_alert_reasons: named community under evacuation with structure involvement or imminent threat

incidents.name: Pear Lake Fire
incidents.location: Thompson-Nicola Regional District and Village of Clinton

evacuation.description: Evacuation orders and alerts remained mapped across regional districts, First Nations, and the Village of Clinton.

incidents.operational_outlook: CIFFC retained Pear Lake as an out-of-control priority fire; current coverage warned of potential aggressive behavior and further growth.

attention.coverage_summary: Coverage focused on smoke effects, readiness for rapid evacuation, and the potential for aggressive behavior and growth.
attention.methodology_note: No auditable public-discussion count was available.

incidents.analyst_note: **Cat-modeling interpretation:** Do not equate about 120 affected properties with destroyed dwellings; reported impacts include non-residential structures and assessment remained incomplete. ([CTV News](https://www.ctvnews.ca/vancouver/article/more-than-100-structures-lost-in-bcs-pear-lake-wildfire-officials-say/))
critical_alert_reasons: named community under evacuation with structure involvement or imminent threat

incidents.name: Rowe Creek Complex
incidents.location: South of Fossil across central Oregon counties
incidents.controlling_agency: Southwest Complex Incident Management Team 2 and Bureau of Land Management

evacuation.description: Incident information retained evacuation, area, road, and trail closure notices.

incidents.operational_outlook: The Aug 9 InciWeb update reported active uphill runs and spotting while crews protected Highway 26; the newer page controls the 367,847-acre, 79%-contained record.

attention.coverage_summary: Coverage focused on Highway 26 protection and the complex's continued growth while containment advanced.
attention.methodology_note: No auditable public-discussion count was available.

incidents.analyst_note: **Cat-modeling interpretation:** The 25-loss total is not classified by occupancy. ([NIFC IMSR](https://www.nifc.gov/nicc/sitreprt.pdf))
critical_alert_reasons: named community under evacuation with structure involvement or imminent threat

global_overview.statement: The reviewed international headline sample was concentrated in Serbia and the wider European wildfire season, with current reporting on Balkan heat and wildfire response plus continuing impacts from fires in Greece, France, and Spain. This is a headline scan, not comprehensive worldwide operational intelligence.

global_events.name: Greece wildfire emergency
global_events.status: New fires and persistent hotspots remained a current headline focus, with continuing life-safety and evacuation reporting.
global_events.evacuations: Current headlines described rescues and evacuations around affected Greek communities.
global_events.summary: The reviewed headline sample did not provide a defensible consolidated current structure-loss total.

global_events.name: France and Spain wildfire impacts
global_events.status: Coverage continued to describe partial respite and recovery alongside ongoing fire-weather risk.
global_events.summary: No new consolidated cross-country operational loss figure was verified in the reviewed headline sample.
